svg.title: Figure 3-SG-04-2. SG-04: from the fault tree to the FMEA
svg.desc: Figure 3-SG-04-2. SG-04: 35 events (backed 28, by design 2, external 5, unbacked 0); 39 FMEA modes reach SG-04 (in the tree 33, justified 5, tree gaps 1). BE-2.12 (HMI hang: render loop or audio stream stalled while processes stay alive (processNotRunning covers crashes only)) → SFM-026, SWF-082: Takeover or disengagement alert not presented; worst cause SFM-026.C1 (UI process hung or display off; O 6, D 10, AP H); detection: No pre-release test targets this cause BE-2.13 (Alert volume not audible (no defined minimum; FFI-CM-18)) → SFM-026: Takeover or disengagement alert not presented; worst cause SFM-026.C1 (UI process hung or display off; O 6, D 10, AP H); detection: No pre-release test targets this cause BE-4.11 (FCW raised from stale or invalid input, or from a false lead (no freshness gate, selfdrived.py:488-493)) → SFM-009, SWF-051: Unintended or excessive deceleration (phantom braking); worst cause SFM-009.C2 (Longitudinal controller overshoot; O 7, D 10, AP H); detection: test_longcontrol.py covers state transitions, not limits UE-4.12 (Driver brakes hard with a close follower): No FMEA row needed: external; WP-C-03 HE-04.5 (driver reflex braking) BE-1.12 (Corrupted/replayed 0x1D2 creates false cruise rising edge with valid 8-bit checksum (no counter, GAP-01)) → SWF-007: Controls allowed without a driver engagement; worst cause SWF-007.C1 (Defect in pcm_cruise_check or PCM_CRUISE decoding (toyota.h rx hook, 0x1D2 bit 5); O 5, D 3, AP H); detection: opendbc safety suite with 100% line coverage and mutation tests, run by fork CI on every change (.github/workflows/safety.yaml, CR-CI-05). At BL-002 the Toyota tests pass locally (287, 34 skipped); mutation was last run locally at BL-001 (2705/2705 killed). Tests are derived from the implementation, not from requirements BE-1.13 (Panda RX path delivers stale/stuck cruise frame to both envelope and SoC (single RX path; CCF → DFI-10)) → SWF-006: Stale brake, cruise or EPS data used beyond the detection budget; worst cause SWF-006.C1 (An RX check lags only after 5 nominal periods plus one 10 ms safety-task period (0x1D2 about 0.16 s, 0x226 about 0.14 s, 0x260 0.11 s, 0xAA about 0.07 s); the budget is not yet confirmed against an FTTI (HARA OI-004) or against real inter-frame gaps (tools/can_gaps); O 4, D 3, AP H); detection: Per-message 5-period timeout test for every Toyota RX check, in the CI safety suite BE-1.14 (MCU fault sets controls_allowed (BE-1.07 class)) → DFM-003: Safety state in SRAM corrupted (controls_allowed, limits, counters, stack); worst cause DFM-003.C1 (Double-bit soft error or permanent SRAM fault; RAMECC monitors not configured, ECC interrupt not registered; O 3, D 10, AP H); detection: No LionDriver hardware verification or qualification test exists for this cause (WP-H-06/WP-H-07 not started; no HIL bench, D-04) BE-1.25 (Envelope software defect in the not-allowed torque check or the controls_allowed bookkeeping (lateral.h:111-114), e.g. a cruise edge refused for MAIN_ON = 0 left the engagement window open (SM-F1, SWF-089; reference build fixed at BL-006, opendbc#17)) → SWF-002, SWF-055, SWF-089: Steering torque passed while controls are not allowed; worst cause SWF-002.C1 (Defect in the not-allowed torque check (lateral.h:111-114) or in controls_allowed bookkeeping; O 5, D 3, AP H); detection: opendbc safety suite with 100% line coverage and mutation tests, run by fork CI on every change (.github/workflows/safety.yaml, CR-CI-05). At BL-002 the Toyota tests pass locally (287, 34 skipped); mutation was last run locally at BL-001 (2705/2705 killed). Tests are derived from the implementation, not from requirements BE-3.10 (Inactive value check bypassed by mode/param change (e.g. param that selects another brake signal or stock-longitudinal branch, toyota.h:216-248)) → SWF-013: Wrong or permissive safety mode accepted from the host; worst cause SWF-013.C1 (Defect in the reference-build allow-list for 0xdc/0xdf and the car-mode request gate; O 3, D 4, AP L); detection: Host unit tests compiled against the real firmware headers, run by panda CI (test.sh): reference_lock and hw_watchdog, 14 tests, pass at BL-002 locally. Not on target hardware BE-4.13 (SoC sends a negative acceleration while not engaged (QM)) → SWF-052: Negative acceleration sent in ACC_CONTROL while longitudinal control is not active; worst cause SWF-052.C1 (The Toyota CarController takes pcm_accel_cmd from actuators.accel with no longActive gate (carcontroller.py:197-250); the inactive value relies on LongControl returning 0 in its off state (longcontrol.py:65-67), so a defect or stale carControl upstream passes through; O 6, D 9, AP H); detection: process_replay covers card on the Corolla segment; not designed for a non-zero request while not engaged BE-4.14 (Authority revoked: envelope accepts only the inactive value at once, with no ramp on the item side) → SWF-053: Active deceleration request ends in one step when authority is revoked; worst cause SWF-053.C1 (By design, the envelope has no ramp-out state after revocation, and the host stops its own request in the same cycle (LongControl off); FSR-04.03 relies on the PCM (TSR-208); O 8, D 9, AP H); detection: No test targets this cause UE-4.15 (PCM steps to the inactive value without its own ramp (AOU-05R)): No FMEA row needed: external; AOU-05R BE-4.19 ((relay stays released; as SG-04)) → DFM-011, SFM-034: Intercept switch stays in pass-through when driven; worst cause SFM-034.C1 (Switch U1 or U2 stuck in intercept, its IN input damaged high or driven high, its pull-down R2/R3 open, or the switches damaged by box supply transients (DG419LE, RR-2026-010); O 4, D 10, AP H); detection: As rated in the DFMEA: no pre-release test of this hardware fault BE-4.20 ((stock 0x343 forwarded while the item transmits; as SG-04)) → SWF-010: Stock camera steering or ACC messages forwarded while the item transmits; worst cause SWF-010.C1 (check_relay flag missing for a replaced message in the TX table, or defect in safety_fwd_hook; O 5, D 3, AP H); detection: opendbc safety suite with 100% line coverage and mutation tests, run by fork CI on every change (.github/workflows/safety.yaml, CR-CI-05). At BL-002 the Toyota tests pass locally (287, 34 skipped); mutation was last run locally at BL-001 (2705/2705 killed). Tests are derived from the implementation, not from requirements BE-4.21 ((relay malfunction detected after 1–2 s, not at all, or cleared by a mode change; as SG-04)) → SWF-012, SWF-090: Relay malfunction not detected; worst cause SWF-012.C1 (Defect in stock_ecu_check, or a replaced message without check_relay; detection starts 1 s after a mode change (safety.h:372-380); O 5, D 3, AP H); detection: opendbc safety suite with 100% line coverage and mutation tests, run by fork CI on every change (.github/workflows/safety.yaml, CR-CI-05). At BL-002 the Toyota tests pass locally (287, 34 skipped); mutation was last run locally at BL-001 (2705/2705 killed). Tests are derived from the implementation, not from requirements BE-4.22 (Host keeps commanding deceleration while the driver presses the accelerator (gasPressed parsed wrong or override not applied)) → SFM-020: Accelerator override not honored; worst cause SFM-020.C1 (gasPressed parsed wrong or missing; O 6, D 9, AP H); detection: As rated in the SW FMEA (SWF-057.C1, D 9 at BL-005): process_replay (CI) replays the TOYOTA3 Corolla TSS2 segment and compares with reference logs made from the same code, so it cannot find a defect already present at the baseline; not designed for this cause BE-4.23 (Envelope passes a non-inactive acceleration while the accelerator is pressed (get_longitudinal_allowed or GAS_RELEASED decoding defect)) → SWF-017: Item deceleration passed while the driver presses the accelerator; worst cause SWF-017.C1 (Defect in get_longitudinal_allowed (controls_allowed && !gas_pressed_prev) or GAS_RELEASED decoding (0x1D2 bit 4); O 5, D 3, AP H); detection: opendbc safety suite with 100% line coverage and mutation tests, run by fork CI on every change (.github/workflows/safety.yaml, CR-CI-05). At BL-002 the Toyota tests pass locally (287, 34 skipped); mutation was last run locally at BL-001 (2705/2705 killed). Tests are derived from the implementation, not from requirements BE-4.24 (GAS_RELEASED stuck "released" while the driver presses: the host and the envelope both read the same 0x1D2 bit (longitudinal.h:3-5)) → SWF-017, SFM-020, SWF-057: Item deceleration passed while the driver presses the accelerator; worst cause SWF-057.C2 (Short frames are not rejected: the parser skips only frames over 64 bytes and reads missing bytes as 0 (parser.py:219, dbc.py:66), so a truncated BRAKE_MODULE reads BRAKE_PRESSED = 0 with no checksum to catch it. Host code unchanged at BL-006; the panda-side length fault is implemented in the reference build since BL-006 (opendbc#18, a safety mechanism of SWF-057); O 3, D 10, AP H); detection: No test targets this cause UE-4.25 (PCM does not give the driver's pedal priority (AOU-05R)): No FMEA row needed: external; AOU-05R (formerly SG-05 UE-5.09)

Worst cause: highest AP, then highest D. Red: single-point path from the gate logic. Text cut with … is given in full in the figure description.
